Items.Name: Manglik Dosha
Items.Description: Manglik Dosha is considered when Mars influences sensitive houses connected with marriage, domestic harmony, and longevity of partnership.

Statements: Partnerships may need patience, direct communication, and conscious anger management.
There can be intensity in emotional reactions during conflict.
Marriage decisions benefit from careful compatibility review and maturity.
Domestic peace may fluctuate when decisions are rushed or ego-driven.
Family adjustment can require active listening and steady boundaries.
A disciplined lifestyle helps reduce friction at home.
Mars can give strong ambition, courage, and ability to act under pressure.
Impulsive professional choices may create avoidable stress.
Leadership improves when energy is directed through planning.
Stress, heat, inflammation, or accident-prone tendencies may need attention.
Exercise and disciplined routines help channel excess Mars energy.
Anger and impatience can affect sleep and physical recovery.
Regular prayer and service can soften harsh Mars expression.
Discipline, humility, and restraint become important spiritual remedies.
Tuesday-based worship routines may support emotional balance.

Remedies: Worship Lord Hanuman or Lord Subramanya on Tuesdays.
Recite Mangal mantra or Hanuman Chalisa with discipline.
Match with another Manglik chart or review cancellation factors before final judgment.

Items.Name: Kaal Sarpa Dosha
Items.Description: Kaal Sarpa Dosha is indicated when all visible planets are enclosed within the Rahu-Ketu axis.

Statements: The native may feel inner pressure, restlessness, or repeated mental loops.
Life can feel extreme during Rahu and Ketu periods.
Emotional stability improves through structure and spiritual grounding.
Progress may come after delays, reversals, or unusual turns.
Recognition can improve once focus and direction become stable.
Unconventional fields, research, technology, or hidden domains may attract the native.
Trust and expectations may need conscious management.
Relationships can feel karmic, intense, or transformative.
Clear communication reduces misunderstandings during stressful periods.
Financial patterns may show sudden gains and sudden expenses.
Speculative decisions should be handled carefully.
Long-term planning helps reduce Rahu-Ketu volatility.
This dosha can push the native toward deeper self-study and detachment.
Rahu-Ketu remedies and mantra practice may bring steadiness.
Service, charity, and disciplined routines reduce karmic pressure.

Remedies: Perform Rahu-Ketu shanti or Navagraha shanti with a qualified priest.
Worship Lord Shiva and recite Mahamrityunjaya mantra.
Strengthen disciplined service, charity, and spiritual practice during Rahu/Ketu periods.

Items.Name: Chandra Grahan Dosha
Items.Description: Chandra Grahan Dosha is considered when Moon is closely associated with Rahu or Ketu, affecting emotional clarity, peace of mind, and mental steadiness.

Statements: Emotional ups and downs, overthinking, or excessive worry may be more noticeable.
The native may find it difficult to maintain mental peace during stressful periods.
Mood swings, sleep disturbance, or vivid dreams can appear when the Moon is activated.
The relationship with mother or maternal figures may feel emotionally fluctuating.
Trust issues, emotional dependency, or emotional detachment may appear in close bonds.
Expressing feelings clearly may require conscious effort and maturity.
Decision-making may feel confused when emotions and fear dominate judgment.
Recognition can be delayed despite effort, especially during Rahu or Ketu periods.
Success often improves after mental maturity and stable direction develop.
Financial decisions may be influenced by mood, anxiety, or impulse.
Savings habits can become inconsistent without a clear plan.
Unexpected gains and losses may appear during Rahu or Ketu periods.
Stress-related issues, headaches, or migraines may need attention.
Sleep disorders or psychosomatic complaints can arise under emotional pressure.
Calming routines and emotional regulation support overall health.
This placement can increase interest in meditation, mantra, and inner healing.
Moon-strengthening practices help build emotional steadiness.
Worship of Lord Shiva and disciplined Monday observances may support peace of mind.

Remedies: Worship Lord Shiva and recite Mahamrityunjaya mantra.
Donate white items such as rice, milk, or cloth on Mondays.
Practice moon-strengthening routines such as meditation, water offerings, and disciplined sleep.
